name: Hanafusa Yukine
source:
Yukine is a former noblewoman and a Vampdoll.

She is brimming with confidence and is no less of a fighter than Ibuki, though she can be a bit naïve about the world sometimes. Talented and hardworking, she always sticks to her word.

At heart, Yukine is a graceful and well-behaved lady. Nevertheless, the more she likes a girl, the more she ends up teasing her. Incidentally, she's head over heels for Sana.

[Translated from [url=https://vampdoll.dojin.com/character/]the official description[/url]. Official translation can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000960/__The_Novel_Game/?beta=1]on Steam.[/url]]
